notes.title: Prison Break is Coming!
notes.notes:
To understand the scale, look at the stones in the middle - this was the lowest point of the game on release

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839405/a8e1489a4233c2ad9db271694a151528a776f2f1.png[/img]

It is worth noting here that the tutorial is linear with little secrets scattered around. If the castle had ornate roots, then the tutorial is more like a branch with berries.

Most of the tutorial is fully designed, while the last part of it still requires adding details in the background.
After that, I will add arenas (there are 2 planned in the tutorial) and I will deal with a new thing - a hint system for the player.

Hope that I can finish everything today.

notes.title: Throwable Update!
notes.notes:
One of the feedback on GwenBlade that I remembered was that the combat is very straightforward - go hit and dodge.

Since then I've done some interesting combat (in another game) and played a lot of different games, of which Sifu with its pick-up and drop weapons really stuck out to me.

Just so the player finds himself in a situation in which without throwing items can not make it
